content.title: This is Barcelona’s lineup to try to beat Newcastle in the Champions League
content.text: Home > Soccer > UEFA Champions League > This is Barcelona’s lineup to try to beat Newcastle in the Champions LeagueThis is Barcelona’s lineup to try to beat Newcastle in the Champions League03/18/2026 - 05:08 PM - by Antonio MedinaBarcelona shakes up its lineup for a decisive European night. There are some key surprises in the starting XI.Barcelona have confirmed their starting lineup to face Newcastle in the second leg of the UEFA Champions League Round of 16, featuring several notable changes. Eric García, Fermín López, and Lamine Yamal return to the starting XI after being benched in the recent LaLiga match against Sevilla, as the team looks to stay fresh for this decisive clash.The Spanish side will line up with Joan García in goal; a back four of Eric García, Cubarsí, Gerard Martín, and João Cancelo; Marc Bernal and Pedri in midfield; and an attacking line of Lamine Yamal, Fermín López, Raphinha, and Robert Lewandowski.Meanwhile, Newcastle, led by Eddie Howe, will start with Ramsdale in goal; Trippier, Thiaw, Burn, and Hall in defense; Tonali, Ramsey, and Joelinton in midfield; and a front three of Elanga, Gordon, and Barnes, aiming to pull off a major upset on Spanish soil.UEFA Champions League
